title: Actionable error recovery
summary: When input or an operation fails, explain what happened, preserve recoverable work, associate the problem with its source, and provide the clearest next action.
problem: Generic errors, erased input, and inaccessible summaries leave users without a recovery path and cause repeated work.
use_when: Forms, uploads, authentication, saves, sync, or network operations can fail
A user can correct input or retry an operation
avoid_when: The system can transparently recover without interrupting the user
A transient non-critical event requires no user action
rationale: Errors are part of a flow, not isolated text.
Preserving valid work reduces recovery cost.
Field-level and summary feedback serve different navigation needs.

prefer_alternatives_if: The failure can be safely recovered without user involvement
use_if: Forms, uploads, authentication, saves, sync, or network operations can fail
A user can correct input or retry an operation

requirements: Associate field errors with the relevant controls.
For page-level form failure, provide an easy-to-find summary and move or announce focus appropriately.
Do not identify errors by color alone.
Say what is wrong and how to fix it.
Offer retry only when retry can plausibly help.
Do not expose internal stack traces.
